# Experimental portable phase-grid reference

This directory vendors the standalone C++ reference prototype from
`/workspace/analysis-completion/prototype`. The ten implementation, header and
test files were copied byte-for-byte. [SOURCE_MANIFEST.json](SOURCE_MANIFEST.json)
records their original and vendored SHA-256 hashes and identifies this snapshot.
The manifest and this README are integration metadata added beside those files.

This is an **experimental independent implementation**, not recovered original
source or a proven output-equivalent reconstruction of the analyzed program.
No raw decompiler output, assembly listing, original binary, model, worker or
audio recording is vendored here.

## Components and contracts

- `transient_detector` is a new, streaming energy-novelty front end. It accepts
  complete interleaved mono or stereo frames and reports events in seconds with
  separate general and bass weights. It is not a reconstruction of the unknown
  original audio-to-transient stage.
- `phase_grid_core` isolates interval voting, tempo consensus, weighted phase
  histograms, multiscale BPM refinement, small geometric phase correction and
  anchor-to-beat reconstruction. Candidate endpoint and phase-wrap behavior are
  explicit policies. Portable double arithmetic and guarded input domains are
  intentional numeric choices, not a claim of original float-level equivalence.
- `analysis_pipeline` requires explicit local-selection, octave-selection and
  coarse-phase callbacks. `proposed_count_only_policies()` is a deliberately
  simplified experimental policy. It does not reproduce all original local-grid,
  octave or bass/four-beat heuristics. The named decompiled-radius-one search
  schedule does not make the entire pipeline equivalent to the original program.
- `core_types.h` defines event values for this implementation. Its three `double`
  fields are not a binary-compatible view of the original 16-byte transient
  layout.

Empty, silent, insufficient or cancelled analysis must not publish a guessed
tempo. The pipeline returns its status and diagnostics explicitly. A returned
candidate is a constant BPM and beat phase; no automatic variable-tempo inference
or musically verified bar/downbeat classification is supplied. Anchor
interpolation is a separate reconstruction operation and retains final working
BPM independently of the explicit beat positions.

Mixxx-specific scheduling, cancellation, settings/cache versions, locked-grid
protection and authoritative result storage belong in a separate adapter. The
portable sources do not call Queen Mary, BeatFactory, BeatGridEvidence, Qt or
Mixxx's track classes. Running a returned result through another estimator or
phase refiner would change the procedure and requires an explicit policy.

## Build target

The code requires C++17 and the standard library only. It is also compatible with
Mixxx's C++20 build. A suitable root CMake target is:

```cmake
add_library(mixxx-phasegrid STATIC
  lib/phasegrid/transient_detector.cpp
  lib/phasegrid/phase_grid_core.cpp
  lib/phasegrid/analysis_pipeline.cpp
)
set_target_properties(mixxx-phasegrid PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_compile_features(mixxx-phasegrid PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
target_include_directories(mixxx-phasegrid PUBLIC
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/phasegrid"
)
```

Each source under `tests/` has a standalone `main()`. Build three separate test
executables linked to `mixxx-phasegrid`; do not add these sources to Mixxx's
existing Google Test executable.

## Verified snapshot checks

The copied files compile with host GCC 14.2 using
`-std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -O2`. All **41 standalone checks pass**:
12 front-end checks, 18 mathematical-core checks and 11 pipeline checks. These
include known synthetic pulse timing, multiple sample rates, chunk invariance,
silence/reset behavior, amplitude-independent phase correction, multiscale
accumulation, endpoint policies, numeric/work limits and marker-tempo ordering.
They are prototype behavior tests, not comparison against the original binary or
proof of accuracy on a representative music collection.

To reproduce without CMake, from the repository root:

```sh
mkdir -p /tmp/mixxx-phasegrid-standalone
g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -O2 -Ilib/phasegrid \
  lib/phasegrid/transient_detector.cpp \
  lib/phasegrid/tests/transient_detector_test.cpp \
  -o /tmp/mixxx-phasegrid-standalone/transient-tests
g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -O2 -Ilib/phasegrid \
  lib/phasegrid/phase_grid_core.cpp \
  lib/phasegrid/tests/phase_grid_core_test.cpp \
  -o /tmp/mixxx-phasegrid-standalone/core-tests
g++ -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -O2 -Ilib/phasegrid \
  lib/phasegrid/transient_detector.cpp lib/phasegrid/phase_grid_core.cpp \
  lib/phasegrid/analysis_pipeline.cpp \
  lib/phasegrid/tests/analysis_pipeline_test.cpp \
  -o /tmp/mixxx-phasegrid-standalone/pipeline-tests
/tmp/mixxx-phasegrid-standalone/transient-tests
/tmp/mixxx-phasegrid-standalone/core-tests
/tmp/mixxx-phasegrid-standalone/pipeline-tests
```

Preserve the recorded source snapshot while establishing native-versus-reference
comparison evidence. Any later algorithm change should update the manifest and
be assessed separately from adapter or build integration changes.
